<b>Slubberlugs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the adolescent form of the [[Muckroach]].

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Slubberlugs swim in water and jump out in an arc to attack. They can grab [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] in their mouths and pull her into the water if the water is reachable by her. Contact damage with a Slubberlug deals {{Damage|1}}; being grabbed in their mouth does {{Damage|1+1}}.

Slubberlugs telegraph their attack by popping their heads above the surface of the water with a splash, tilting toward the direction they will jump in.

While killing a Slubberlug knocks it back a significant distance and changes its trajectory, it still wriggles around as it falls, attempting to catch Hornet in its mouth. If this succeeds, Hornet will take {{Damage|1+1}} and will be pulled down into the infested water if possible.

If a Slubberlug lands on solid ground, it wriggles back into the water.

Due to the brief window of a Slubberlug landing on the ground and the timing of its jump, it is recommended to use [[Needle Strike]] or [[Silk Skills]] to kill them.

== Location ==
Slubberlugs are found in [[Bilewater]], in the large dead-end tunnel midway up the map on the right.
